'Agentic system' (actor variety) and 'Misalignment' (motive) are VERIS 1.4.2 enums not yet in VCDB's vcdb-merged.json; the record validates against vcdb-merged.json with those 1.4.2 enums added and passes veris checkValidity.py (Agentic system is never the sole actor variety).
Action: initial access methods are not named in the sources -> hacking Unknown. Skimmers -> malware Capture app data, vector Direct install (placed after access). Cleanup wiped card fields from Magento databases (integrity Modify data) and in one case deleted 180 tables (availability Destruction).
Data: 600,000+ payment card records from two victims -> Payment (+ Personal parent).
Timeline: campaign active since at least July 2026 (issue says 2024; sources say 2026) -> dbir_year 2027.
Confidence Low: unnamed victims and a single research firm's account.
Data: the 600,000+ card records came from two victims, assigned to 24460-1 and 24460-2. For this victim, data type and disclosure are Unknown. Exfiltrate removed from action results for the same reason.

event_chain.summary: Data theft from this victim not confirmed

summary: Gambit Security found that a single, financially motivated, Chinese-speaking operator used three open-source AI agent frameworks (Strix for scanning, Cairn for autonomous exploitation, Hermes for orchestration, directed with Claude Opus 4.6) to attack 105 targets and compromise at least 27 organizations between July and mid-September 2026, including a Fortune 500 hospitality company, a major US airline, an industrial supplies distributor and an online fashion retailer. The agents stole over 600,000 unexpired payment card records from two victims, planted web skimmers (one re-injected by cron every two minutes), wiped card fields from Magento databases and in one case deleted 180 database tables. Gambit recovered the attacker's staging server.
